events.title: King David II of Scotland captured at Neville's Cross
events.description: Scotland's King David II led an invasion of northern England. English forces intercepted his army near Durham and defeated it. Many Scottish nobles were killed or captured, and David himself was taken prisoner. He was held in England for eleven years.
events.significance: The defeat crippled Scotland's invasion and left the country without its king for over a decade.

events.title: Burgoyne surrenders at Saratoga
events.description: British General John Burgoyne surrendered his army of roughly 5,000 British and Hessian troops to American forces under General Horatio Gates in upstate New York.
events.significance: The American victory helped persuade France to enter the Revolutionary War as an ally of the United States.

events.title: Cornwallis surrenders at Yorktown
events.description: British General Charles Cornwallis offered to surrender his army at Yorktown, Virginia, after a siege by American and French forces. This brought the last major land campaign of the Revolutionary War to a close.
events.significance: The surrender effectively ended major fighting in the war and paved the way for American independence.

events.title: The London Beer Flood
events.description: Vats at the Meux and Company Brewery in London burst. Hundreds of thousands of litres of beer poured into the surrounding streets. Eight people died.
events.significance: One of the strangest industrial disasters in history, it is still remembered as a vivid example of the hazards of early industrial engineering.

events.title: Loma Prieta earthquake strikes California
events.description: A magnitude 6.9 earthquake struck near Loma Prieta Peak in the Santa Cruz Mountains at 5:04 p.m. local time. The shaking lasted about 15 to 20 seconds and was felt across the San Francisco Bay Area. About 60 people died, mostly in collapsed structures and landslides.
events.significance: The quake prompted major advances in earthquake engineering and seismic safety standards in California.
